derivation: Compare g00_eff=-1+2*A1*X-2*A2*X^2 with PPN g00=-1+2*U-2*beta*U^2 using U=A1*X.
The local-GR beta residual is exactly the failure of the parent second-order coefficient to equal the square of the first-order coefficient.
This is the 3738 beta-row coefficient if A1 and A2 are finite and source-owned.
The non-smuggled local-GR route is a parent theorem forcing A2=A1^2, not a fitted beta row.
